svg.title: R2-D2 looking right within the original forest
svg.metadata: The R2-D2 droid is a detailed editable vector drawing based on a flat reference supplied by the project owner. Its head and cylindrical body face toward the right and stay entirely within the forest circle. The original archived Shambu forest PNG is embedded unchanged. An imagegen background-only repair is clipped to the former character and binocular footprint. All forest outside that footprint and the clipped original foreground leaves use the original source image. The repair fills previously hidden areas; it is not a replacement for the visible original forest. See ORIGIN.txt, forest-subject-fill.prompt.txt, and docs/branding.md for exact sources and attribution. The final droid does not use the former LibreICONS glyph. The existing droid is scaled 25 percent larger for prominence and raised within the circle. Original upper foreground leaves sit behind the droid, while the lowest original leaves overlap its base. Both embedded forest images and the standalone droid drawing are unchanged by this refinement.
